title: Structure-Aware Row Scaling for Block-Structured Mixed-Integer Programs

creators.name: Rodríguez Castro, Mathias
creators.affiliation: Facultad de Ingeniería, Universidad de la República, Uruguay

description: Reproducibility repository for the paper "Structure-Aware Row Scaling for Block-Structured Mixed-Integer Programs" (International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering). It contains the cleaned C++ preprocessing and monolithic-MIP platform, the hydrothermal-dispatch and synthetic block-structured instances, the aggregate per-scenario results (resumen.csv) with manifests and checksums, the analysis and validation scripts, and the manuscript source. The neural-network (LSTM) and Dantzig-Wolfe / column-generation code of the broader project is not included. Source code is released under MIT; the data and aggregate results are released under CC BY 4.0. The manuscript under paper/ is not covered by those licenses: all rights reserved pending journal publication, and it is shared as a submitted-version preprint under the publisher's self-archiving policy. The full per-instance solver logs and dispatch CSVs are attached to the GitHub release as external archives.
